# NFL Daily — 2026-11-25 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Steelers release QB Aaron Rodgers after he accused coach Mike McCarthy of sleeping through meetings on the Pat McAfee Show; Mason Rudolph takes over at QB. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50595660/rodgers-heard-mccarthy-benching)
- Micah Parsons is cleared to make his season debut for the Packers after tearing his ACL. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/nfl-thanksgiving-injury-report-micah-parsons-cleared-kenneth-walker-iii-practices/)
- Broncos suspend RB J.K. Dobbins one game for conduct detrimental to the team, sidelining him for Friday's game vs. the Steelers. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50586087/broncos-payton-says-rb-dobbins-suspended-one-game)
- Longtime Lions owner Martha Firestone Ford dies at age 101. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50588773/long-lions-owner-martha-firestone-ford-dies-age-101)
- Brandon Aiyuk signs with the Commanders' practice squad, reuniting with QB Jayden Daniels days after his 49ers exit. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50595281/brandon-aiyuk-finishes-visit-commanders)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Ravens RB Derrick Henry (concussion protocol) was limited in practice but is expected to play Sunday vs. the Texans. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2125678379563094202)
- Chargers QB Justin Herbert (concussion) won't practice Wednesday, per coach Jim Harbaugh. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- 49ers QB Brock Purdy (ankle) is uncertain to face the Seahawks; Sam Darnold (quad) is trending toward playing. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7812454/2026/11/25/brock-purdy-injury-49ers-seahawks/)
- Patriots WR A.J. Brown (hamstring) is doubtful after not practicing Wednesday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) is ruled out for Thursday's Thanksgiving game vs. the Bills; rookie Emmett Johnson starts again. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50594656/chiefs-rb-kenneth-walker-iii-groin-thursday-vs-bills)
- Cowboys TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) is ruled out for Thursday's Thanksgiving game vs. the Eagles. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
